state_and_ABI_limits.mode: Physical interpretation uses default 32-bit operand/address sizes. Current execution mode, code/segment descriptors, mappings, permissions and values remain unestablished.
state_and_ABI_limits.explicit_SS_address: BFBB61 uses current SS with explicit (ESP+4) modulo 2^32. This MOV address calculation itself does not require SS.B=1. It writes EAX and leaves ESP/EFLAGS unchanged on normal completion.
state_and_ABI_limits.each_stack_operation: Renew current SS.B=1 at every PUSH, POP, CALL and RET where the description uses ESP. Each PUSH/CALL writes four bytes through current SS at (ESP-4) modulo 2^32; each POP/RET reads four bytes through current SS and advances ESP by four on normal completion. No flat linear address or segment equality is assumed.
state_and_ABI_limits.call_boundaries: Both direct near calls remain opaque. Encoded return offsets BFBB71 and BFBB81 do not prove return. If a call returns, all relevant current registers, flags, segment state and memory values are unestablished unless separately evidenced. Do not carry the earlier ESI=0, EAX value, ESP, stack cells or ABI preservation across either call.
state_and_ABI_limits.five_pushes: The five ESI pushes at BFBB71..BFBB75 read current ESI after the first opaque call; their values are unknown. The prior XOR ESI,ESI does not prove five zero arguments.
state_and_ABI_limits.memory_referents: The DS memory operands [EAX], [0109DD84] and [0109DD90] establish encoded addressing only. No cell content, pointer validity, writability, nonaliasing, getter identity or provider identity is established. Stores may alias stack or other memory; faults remain possible.
state_and_ABI_limits.arithmetic_flags: CMP and ADD affect AF/CF/OF/PF/SF/ZF; XOR changes PF/SF/ZF, clears CF/OF and leaves AF undefined. JZ/JNZ test current ZF. ADD ESP,20 is explicit 32-bit arithmetic and does not itself require SS.B=1.
state_and_ABI_limits.local_zeroing: Normal XOR ESI,ESI establishes ESI=0 locally before the first branch. Normal XOR EAX,EAX at BFBB99 establishes EAX=0 locally. Neither fact authenticates an overall function signature or return contract.
state_and_ABI_limits.return: RET at BFBB88 and BFBB9C takes its target from current SS stack state; targets are unknown. No aggregate stack balance, restored caller ESI, calling convention, argument meaning or ABI compatibility follows.
state_and_ABI_limits.identity: __get_winmajor and the two LIBCRT_unmatched callee labels plus no_return=false/nonthunk flags are saved metadata only.
state_and_ABI_limits.stop: BFBB9D, both callees, both absolute memory referents, providers and prototypes remain unqueried.
